title: Use of Artificial Intelligence for the Interpretable Prediction of the Pathologic Diagnosis and Molecular Abnormalities of Flat Urothelial Lesions.
authors: Nishikawa, Toui; Matsuzaki, Ibu; Ryuta, Iwamoto; Musangile, Fidele Y; Sagan, Kanako; Nishikawa, Mizuki; Mikasa, Yurina; Takahashi, Yuichi; Kojima, Fumiyoshi; Murata, Shin-Ichi
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用AI从病理图像预测尿路上皮病变诊断和分子异常，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Flat urothelial lesions are important because of their potential for carcinogenesis and development into invasive urothelial carcinomas. However, it is difficult for pathologists to detect early flat urothelial changes and accurately diagnose flat urothelial lesions. To predict the pathologic diagnosis and molecular abnormalities of flat urothelial lesions from pathologic images, artificial intelligence with an interpretable method was used. Next-generation sequencing on 110 hematoxylin and eosin-stained slides of normal urothelium and flat urothelial lesions, including atypical urothelium, dysplasia, and carcinoma in situ, detected 17 types of molecular abnormalities. To generate an interpretable prediction, a new method for segmenting urothelium and a new pathologic criteria-based artificial intelligence (PCB-AI) model was developed. kappa Statistics and accuracy measurements were used to evaluate the ability of the model to predict the pathologic diagnosis. The likelihood ratio test was performed to evaluate the logistic regression models for predicting molecular abnormalities. The diagnostic prediction of the PCB-AI model was almost in perfect agreement with the pathologists' diagnoses (weighted kappa = 0.98). PCB-AI significantly predicted some molecular abnormalities in an interpretable manner, including abnormalities of TP53 (P = 0.02), RB1 (P = 0.04), and ERCC2 (P = 0.04). Thus, this study developed a new method of obtaining accurate urothelial segmentation, interpretable prediction of pathologic diagnosis, and interpretable prediction of molecular abnormalities.
abstract_zh: 平坦尿路上皮病变因其具有致癌潜能及进展为浸润性尿路上皮癌的可能性而具有重要意义。然而，病理学家难以检测早期平坦尿路上皮变化并准确诊断平坦尿路上皮病变。为从病理图像预测平坦尿路上皮病变的病理诊断及分子异常，采用了具有可解释方法的人工智能。对110张正常尿路上皮及平坦尿路上皮病变（包括非典型尿路上皮、异型增生及原位癌）的苏木精-伊红染色切片进行下一代测序，检测到17种分子异常类型。为生成可解释的预测，开发了一种新的尿路上皮分割方法及基于病理标准的人工智能（PCB-AI）模型。采用kappa统计量和准确性测量评估模型预测病理诊断的能力。进行似然比检验以评估预测分子异常的logistic回归模型。PCB-AI模型的诊断预测与病理学家的诊断几乎完全一致（加权kappa = 0.98）。PCB-AI以可解释方式显著预测了某些分子异常，包括TP53（P = 0.02）、RB1（P = 0.04）及ERCC2（P = 0.04）的异常。因此，本研究开发了一种新方法，可获得准确的尿路上皮分割、病理诊断的可解释预测及分子异常的可解释预测。
